analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($60,737.54) above SMA5 ($60,647.28), below SMA20 ($65,951.68): indicating short-term bearish turn, below mid-term trend.
· Significantly below SMA100 ($77,481.74) / SMA200 ($71,921.45): maintaining strong mid-to-long-term bearish trend.
· 52-week position (13.1%) + current price range entering rebound zone from 52-week low ($55,149.57).
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (22.7→29.0): attempting to exit oversold zone but failing to break 30, weak rebound signal.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-989.2040→-68.7106): improving within negative territory, entering bearish convergence.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower Band $54,339.39): approaching lower band, band width at 35.21% suggests potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($60,074.2): support zone based on Pivot S1 ($51,878.51) and SMA5 ($60,647.28).
· Swing Resistance ($65,401.69): close to SMA20 ($65,951.68), potential for strengthened short-term rebound upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Attempting Higher Low): 5-day low 57,241.84 > 20-day low 55,149.57, potential recovery signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.88x): subdued compared to 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation Zone): maintaining wait-and-see conditions due to delayed RSI oversold exit and subdued volume.
